requests.title: Define what makes an element GOOD — per element type and per package
requests.stage_note: Deliberately NOT now. Runs entirely IN THE APP, using the room/conversation engine, once the M2 class collapse lands (Room + Agent classes) so the debate has real surfaces to run on and produces a committed artifact per P-visible-work.
requests.why: Every scoring decision in the hub currently leans on a single 1-10 quality_score whose rubric is generic across all nine element types. A prompt, an MCP connector and a design are good for completely different reasons, so one rubric cannot judge them. Without per-type guidelines the trust gate, the output quality bar (END PLAN M.107) and the self-improvement dept are all grading against a vague standard.

scope.deliverable: One written guideline set per element type plus one for packages: what GOOD looks like, what MEDIOCRE looks like, what disqualifies, and the observable signals that decide it.

process.engine: room/conversation engine (M2.5) — agents debate, converge, and commit an artifact (M2.6)

phases.name: Independent brainstorm
phases.rule: Each agent drafts its own guidelines ALONE, with no visibility of the others' drafts. No cross-talk in this phase — simultaneous, not sequential, so nobody anchors on whoever spoke first.
phases.output: one independent draft per agent, all committed

phases.name: Integration discussion
phases.rule: Agents discuss and merge ONLY the strongest points they genuinely agree on. Agreement must be real convergence, not averaging — a point kept by consensus is recorded with who backed it and why.
phases.output: one integrated guideline set per element type

phases.name: Adversarial re-review FROM SCRATCH
phases.rule: Each agent reviews the integrated guidelines fresh, explicitly hunting for weaknesses — gaps, cases the rubric misjudges, criteria that cannot actually be observed. Reviewing from scratch is the point: do NOT let phase-2 reasoning carry over and defend itself.

phases.name: Resolution discussion
phases.rule: Second discussion round resolving the weaknesses found in phase 3 into the final guidelines.
phases.output: the final committed guideline set per element type + package

process.diversity_requirement: Agents in this room MUST span different model families (END PLAN §2: same-model-with-a-prompt-twist is banned — it produces correlated errors, which would defeat the entire point of an independent-brainstorm-then-critique process).

requests.done_criteria: A committed artifact per element type and for packages, each carrying all four phases' output (independent drafts, integrated set, weakness lists, final set), produced by a real in-app room — readable in the app, not a document written by Claude outside it.
depends_on: M2 class collapse: Room + Agent classes
